The user mimics the move used immediately before
it. The move fails if no other move has been
used yet.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_384
text:
The user employs its psychic power to switch
changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with
the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_385
text:
The user employs its psychic power to switch
changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with
the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_386
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_387
text:
This move can be used only after the user has used
all the other moves it knows in the battle.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_388
text:
A seed that causes worry is planted on the target.
It prevents sleep by making the target’s
Ability Insomnia.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_389
text:
This move enables the user to attack first. This move
fails if the target is not readying an attack.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_390
text:
The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of
the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing
Pokémon that switch into battle.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_391
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_392
text:
The user envelops itself in a veil made of water.
It regains some HP every turn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_393
text:
The user levitates using electrically generated
magnetism for five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_394
text:
The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target.
This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack
may leave the target with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_395
text:
The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may
also leave the target with paralysis.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_396
text:
The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep
within its body at the target. This attack
never misses.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_397
text:
The user polishes its body to reduce drag.
This sharply raises the Speed stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_398
text:
The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like
steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_399
text:
The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark
thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_400
text:
The user slashes the target the instant an
opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_401
text:
The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a
vicious wave in a raging storm.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_402
text:
The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds
down on the target from above.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_403
text:
The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even
the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_404
text:
The user slashes at the target by crossing its
scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_405
text:
The user generates a damaging sound wave by
vibration. This may also lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_406
text:
The target is attacked with a shock wave generated
by the user’s gaping mouth.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_407
text:
The user tackles the target while exhibiting
overwhelming menace. This may also make the
target flinch.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_408
text:
The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as
if it were made of gemstones.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_409
text:
An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored
by half the damage taken by the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_410
text:
The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure
vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_411
text:
The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes
its power. This may also lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_412
text:
The user draws power from nature and fires it at the
target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_413
text:
The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low
altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_414
text:
The user makes the ground under the target erupt
with power. This may also lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_415
text:
The user trades held items with the target faster
than the eye can follow.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_416
text:
The user charges at the target using every bit of its
power. The user can’t move on the next turn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_417
text:
The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad
thoughts. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_418
text:
The user strikes the target with tough punches as
fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_419
text:
The power of this attack move is doubled if the user
has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_420
text:
The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them
at the target. This move always goes first.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_421
text:
The user slashes with a sharp claw made from
shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_422
text:
The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also
make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_423
text:
The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may
also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_424
text:
The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may
also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_425
text:
The user extends its shadow and attacks the target
from behind. This move always goes first.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_426
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_427
text:
The user tears at the target with blades formed by
psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_428
text:
The user focuses its willpower to its head and
attacks the target. This may also make the
target flinch.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_429
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_430
text:
The user gathers all its light energy and releases it
all at once. This may also lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_431
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_432
text:
A strong wind blows away the target’s barriers such
as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the
target’s evasiveness.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_433
text:
The user creates a bizarre area in which slower
Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_434
text:
Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the
target. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s
Sp. Atk stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_435
text:
The user strikes everything around it by letting loose
a flare of electricity. This may also cause paralysis.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_436
text:
The user torches everything around it in an inferno
of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits
with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_437
text:
The user whips up a storm of leaves around the
target. The attack’s recoil harshly lowers the user’s
Sp. Atk stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_438
text:
The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the
like to harshly lash the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_439
text:
The user launches a huge boulder at the target to
attack. The user can’t move on the next turn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_440
text:
A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may
also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_441
text:
The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to
attack. This may also poison the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_442
text:
The user slams the target with its steel-hard head.
This may also make the target flinch.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_443
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_444
text:
The user stabs the target from below with
sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_445
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_446
text:
The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the
opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon
that switch into battle.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_447
text:
The user snares the target with grass and trips it.
The heavier the target, the greater the
move’s power.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_448
text:
The user attacks the target with sound waves of
deafening chatter. This confuses the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_449
text:
The user releases countless shots of light at the
target. This move’s type varies depending on the
kind of Plate the user is holding.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_450
text:
The user bites the target. If the target is holding a
Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_451
text:
The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The
user may use any remaining electricity to raise its
Sp. Atk stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_452
text:
The user slams its rugged body into the target to
attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_453
text:
The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes
it almost invisible. This move always goes first.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_454
text:
The user calls out its underlings to pummel the
target. Critical hits land more easily.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_455
text:
The user calls out its underlings to shield its body,
raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_456
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_457
text:
The user attacks the target with a hazardous,
full-power headbutt. This also damages the
user terribly.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_458
text:
The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or a
tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_459
text:
The user blasts the target with power that distorts
even time. The user can’t move on the next turn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_460
text:
The user tears the target along with the space
around it. Critical hits land more easily.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_461
text:
The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its
place will have its status and HP fully restored.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_462
text:
The target is crushed with great force. The more HP
the target has left, the greater this move’s power.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_463
text:
The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of
fire that rages for four to five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_464
text:
Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total
darkness that makes them sleep.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_465
text:
The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack
its target. This may also harshly lower the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_466
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_467
text:
The user disappears, then strikes the target on the
next turn. This move hits even if the target
protects itself.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_468
text:
The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat
and accuracy.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_469
text:
The user and its allies are protected from
wide-ranging attacks for one turn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_470
text:
The user employs its psychic power to average its
Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_471
text:
The user employs its psychic power to average its
Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_472
text:
The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s
Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for
five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_473
text:
The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack
the target. This attack does physical damage.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_474
text:
The user drenches the target in a special poisonous
liquid. This move’s power is doubled if the target
is poisoned.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_475
text:
The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter
and sharply raise its Speed stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_476
text:
The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to
draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at
the user.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_477
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_478
text:
The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon’s
held items lose their effects for five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_479
text:
The user throws a stone or similar projectile to
attack the target. A flying Pokémon will fall to the
ground when it’s hit.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_480
text:
The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This
attack always results in a critical hit.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_481
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_482
text:
The user strikes everything around it by swamping
the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also
poison those hit.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_483
text:
The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance.
This boosts the user’s Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and
Speed stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_484
text:
The user slams into the target with its heavy body.
The more the user outweighs the target, the greater
the move’s power.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_485
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_486
text:
The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The
faster the user is than the target, the greater the
move’s power.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_487
text:
The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and
changes the target’s type to Water.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_488
text:
Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target.
Then, building up more power, the user raises its
Speed stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_489
text:
The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its
Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_490
text:
The user makes a swift attack on the target’s legs,
which lowers the target’s Speed stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_491
text:
The user spits fluid that works to melt the target.
This harshly lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_492
text:
The user turns the target’s power against it.
The higher the target’s Attack stat, the greater
the damage it deals.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_493
text:
The user’s mysterious psychic wave changes the
target’s Ability to Simple.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_494
text:
The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels
the target to mimic it, making the target’s Ability
the same as the user’s.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_495
text:
The user helps the target and makes it use its move
right after the user.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_496
text:
The user attacks the target with a song. Others can
join in the Round to increase the power of
the attack.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_497
text:
The user attacks the target with an echoing voice.
If this move is used every turn, its power
is increased.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_498
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_499
text:
The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of
special mud. All stat changes are returned to normal.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_500
text:
The user attacks the target with stored power.
The more the user’s stats are raised, the greater
the move’s power.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_501
text:
The user protects itself and its allies from
priority moves.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_502
text:
The user teleports using a strange power and
switches places with one of its allies.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_503
text:
The user shoots boiling hot water at its target.
This may also leave the target with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_504
text:
The user breaks its shell, which lowers Defense and
Sp. Def stats but sharply raises its Attack, Sp. Atk,
and Speed stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_505
text:
The user emits a healing pulse that restores the
target’s HP by up to half of its max HP.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_506
text:
This relentless attack does massive damage to a
target affected by status conditions.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_507
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_508
text:
The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack stat and
sharply raising its Speed stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_509
text:
The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is
dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against
a single Pokémon.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_510
text:
The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire.
If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a
Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_511
text:
The user suppresses the target and makes its move
go last.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_512
text:
The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not
holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_513
text:
The user reflects the target’s type, making the user the
same type as the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_514
text:
The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally
fainted in the previous turn, this move’s power
is increased.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_515
text:
The user risks everything to attack its target. The
user faints but does damage equal to its HP.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_516
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_517
text:
The user attacks by engulfing the target in an
intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_518
text:
A column of water hits the target. When used with
its fire equivalent, its power increases and a
rainbow appears.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_519
text:
A column of fire hits the target. When used with its
grass equivalent, its power increases and a vast sea
of fire appears.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_520
text:
A column of grass hits the target. When used with
its water equivalent, its power increases and a vast
swamp appears.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_521
text:
After making its attack, the user rushes back to
switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_522
text:
While resisting, the user attacks opposing Pokémon.
This lowers the Sp. Atk stats of those hit.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_523
text:
The user strikes everything around it by stomping
down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of
those hit.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_524
text:
The user blows its cold breath on the target. This
attack always results in a critical hit.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_525
text:
The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon
is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against
a single Pokémon.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_526
text:
The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk
stats increase.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_527
text:
The user attacks and captures opposing Pokémon
using an electric net. This lowers their Speed stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_528
text:
The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes
into its target. This also damages the user a little.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_529
text:
The user crashes into its target while rotating its
body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_530
text:
The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal
strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_531
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_532
text:
The user drains the target’s energy with its horns.
The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken
by the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_533
text:
The user attacks by slicing with a long horn. The
target’s stat changes don’t affect this
attack’s damage.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_534
text:
The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This may
also lower the target’s Defense stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_535
text:
The user slams its target with its flame-covered
body. The more the user outweighs the target, the
greater the move’s power.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_536
text:
The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp
leaves. This attack may also lower the
target’s accuracy.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_537
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_538
text:
The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft
cotton, which drastically raises the user’s
Defense stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_539
text:
The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its
target. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_540
text:
The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack
the target. This attack does physical damage.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_541
text:
The user attacks by striking the target with its hard
tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_542
text:
The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a
fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also
confuse the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_543
text:
The user charges its head into its target, using its
powerful guard hair. This also damages the user
a little.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_544
text:
The user attacks by throwing steel gears at its
target twice.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_545
text:
The user torches everything around it in an inferno
of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits
with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_546
text:
The user fires a beam of light at its target. The
move’s type changes depending on the Drive the
user holds.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_547
text:
The user sings an ancient song and attacks by
appealing to the hearts of the listening opposing
Pokémon. This may also induce sleep.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_548
text:
The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power
contained in the horn does physical damage to
the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_549
text:
The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at
opposing Pokémon. This lowers their Speed stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_550
text:
The user surrounds itself with a great amount of
electricity and charges its target. This may also
leave the target with paralysis.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_551
text:
The user attacks by engulfing the target in an
intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This may also leave
the target with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_552
text:
Cloaked in flames, the user attacks the target by
dancing and flapping its wings. This may also raise the
user’s Sp. Atk stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_553
text:
On the second turn, the user hits the target with
electrically charged ice. This may also leave the
target with paralysis.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_554
text:
On the second turn, an ultracold, freezing wind
surrounds the target. This may leave the target with
a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_555
text:
The user yells as if it’s ranting about something,
which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_556
text:
The user attacks by harshly dropping large icicles
onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_557
text:
With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself
at its target. This lowers the user’s Defense, Sp. Def,
and Speed stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_558
text:
The user brings down a giant flame. This move’s
power is increased when influenced by an enormous
lightning bolt.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_559
text:
The user throws down a giant lightning bolt. This
move’s power is increased when influenced by an
enormous flame.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_560
text:
The user dives down onto the target from the sky.
This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_561
text:
Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects
itself and its allies from damaging moves. This does
not stop status moves.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_562
text:
The user lets out a damaging belch at the target.
The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_563
text:
This move can’t be used.
It’s recommended that this move is forgotten.
Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_564
text:
The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing
team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching
into battle.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_565
text:
When the user knocks out a target with this move,
the user’s Attack stat rises drastically.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_566
text:

target on the next turn. This move hits even if the
target protects itself.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_568

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_571

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_572

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_573

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_574

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_575

party Pokémon.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_576

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_577

taken by the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_578
text:

moves that do damage.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_579

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_580

little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_581

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_582

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_583

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_584

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_585

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_586

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_587

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_588

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_589

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_592

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_593

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_594

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_595

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_596

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_597

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_598

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_599

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_600

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_601

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_602

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_603

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_604

The user electrifies the ground for five turns,

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_605

The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a
powerful flash.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_606
text: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_607

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_608

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_609

The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_610

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_611

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_612

Striking opponents over and over makes the user’s

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_613

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_614

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_615

The user attacks with a wave that crawls along

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_616

The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_617

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_618
text:

beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_619

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_620
text:
After soaring upward, the user attacks its target by

its own Defense and Sp. Def stats in the process.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_621
text:
Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of
attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect
and Detect. But the user’s Defense stat falls.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_742
text:
The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest,
and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may
also make the target flinch.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_743
text:
This move enables the user to protect itself from
all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used
in succession.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_744
text:
The user unleashes a strong beam from its core.
This move deals twice the damage if the target
is Dynamaxed.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_745
text:
The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon’s
moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this
move to hit the chosen target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_746
text:
This move prevents the user and the target from
switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes
away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_747
text:
The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its
Defense stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_748
text:
This move raises all the user’s stats but prevents
the user from switching out or fleeing.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_749
text:
The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the
target’s Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to
Fire-type moves.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_750
text:
The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that
changes the target to Psychic type.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_751
text:
The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two
targets, this move hits each target once.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_752
text:
The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle.
Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_753
text:
The user locks the target in and prevents it from
fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense
and Sp. Def every turn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_754
text:
The user stabs the target with its electrified beak.
If the user attacks before the target, the power of this
move is doubled.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_755
text:
The user rends the target with its hard gills.
If the user attacks before the target, the power of this
move is doubled.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_756
text:
With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on
either side of the field.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_757
text:
This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user intensifies the sun for five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_758
text:
This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_759
text:
This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for
five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_760
text:

This lowers the target’s Speed stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_761
text:
This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Attack stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_762
text:
This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This lowers the target’s Defense stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_763
text:
This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_764
text:
This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Atk stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_765
text:
This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user summons a heavy rain that falls for
five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_766
text:
This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Speed stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_767
text:

The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for
five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_768
text:
This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This lowers the target’s Attack stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_769
text:
This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for
five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_770
text:
This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_771
text:
This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Sp. Def stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_772
text:
This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This lowers the target’s Sp. Def stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_773
text:
This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for
five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_774
text:
This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use.
This raises ally Pokémon’s Defense stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_775
text: The user raises all its stats by using some of its HP.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_776
text:
The user attacks by slamming its body into the target.
The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can
inflict on the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_777
text:
The user sharply raises the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk
stats by decorating the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_778
text:
The user plays its drum, controlling the drum’s roots
to attack the target. This also lowers the target’s
Speed stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_779
text:
The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to
five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_780
text:
The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching
it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the
target with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_781
text:
The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target.
This move deals twice the damage if the target
is Dynamaxed.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_782
text:
The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into
the target. This move deals twice the damage if the
target is Dynamaxed.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_783
text:
Morpeko attacks and raises its Speed with the energy
stored in its cheeks. This move’s type changes
depending on the user’s form.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_784
text:
The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks
opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_785
text:
The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply
pointed branch.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_786
text:
The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging
a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and
strong vibration.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_787
text:
The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created
from tart apples. This also lowers the target’s
Sp. Def stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_788
text:
The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from
high above. This also lowers the target’s Defense stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_789
text:
The user attacks the target with so much force that it
could break the target’s spirit. This also lowers the
target’s Sp. Atk stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_790
text:
The user attacks the target by emitting steam.
This may also confuse the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_791
text:
The user scatters mysterious water around and restores
the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon in the battle.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_792
text:
This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks.
Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker’s Defense stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_793
text:
The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the
target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_794
text:
The user attacks wildly with its thick leek.
The user can’t move on the next turn, because the
force of this move makes it stagger.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_795
text:
This is Eternatus’s most powerful attack in its original
form. The user can’t move on the next turn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_796
text:
The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its
entire body. This also damages the user.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_797
text:
The user attacks the target with its psychic power.
This move’s power goes up and damages all opposing
Pokémon on Psychic Terrain.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_798
text:
The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move
fails when the ground hasn’t turned into a terrain.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_799
text:
The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times
in a row. This move boosts the user’s Speed stat but
lowers its Defense stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_800
text:
In this two-turn attack, the user gathers space power
and boosts its Sp. Atk stat, then attacks the target
on the next turn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_801
text:
This move inflicts physical or special damage,
whichever will be more effective. This may also poison
the target.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_802
text:
The user attacks everything around it and faints upon
using this move. This move’s power is increased on
Misty Terrain.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_803
text:
Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target.
This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_804
text:
The user attacks with electric voltage rising from
the ground. This move’s power doubles when the target
is on Electric Terrain.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_805
text:
The user utilizes the power of the terrain to attack.
This move’s type and power changes depending on
the terrain when it’s used.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_806
text:
The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also
lowers the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_807
text:
The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves
all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted
during the turn with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_808
text:
The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward
the target. If the user’s stats were lowered during this
turn, the power of this move is doubled.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_809
text:
The user attacks the target by controlling the target’s
item. The move fails if the target doesn’t have an item.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_810
text:
The user surrounds everything around it with
highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_811
text:
The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon,
boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_812
text:
After making its attack, the user rushes back to
switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_813
text:
A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more
powerful with each successful hit.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_814
text:
The user slams the target with its wings.
The target is hit twice in a row.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_815
text:
The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack.
This may also leave the target with a burn.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_816
text:
The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP
and healing any status conditions of itself and its ally
Pokémon in battle.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_817
text:
The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the
target with a fierce blow. This attack always results
in a critical hit.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_818
text:
The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the
target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This
attack always results in a critical hit.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_819
text:
The user traps the target in a cage of sparking
electricity for four to five turns.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_820
text:
Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks
opposing Pokémon. The lower the user’s HP, the lower
the move’s power.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_821
text:
The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes
to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_822
text:
The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura
to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_823
text:
The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like
movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers
the target’s Defense stat.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_824
text:
The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked
icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_825
text:
The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small
ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

label: WAZAINFO_SWSH_826
text:
The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power.
This also removes 3 PP from the target’s last move.
